published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Undead; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 941.8 as a Human on the same sim)

summary: The twist build with its side points in Holy instead of Protection, on Seal of Righteousness twisted to Seal of Command. The class default: 4.0 ahead of twist at 180s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Command at -3s, Seal of Righteousness at -1.5s so the first swing gets the Echo
Hammer of Wrath below 20% health, ahead of Consecration
Consecration on cooldown while mana is at or above 20%
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Twist: with Seal of Righteousness up, swap to Seal of Command in the last 1.5s before a swing, and back to Righteousness before the next swing (one swap per swing, at any mana); Twist of Light's Echo applies the old seal on the next swing
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Dragonfire Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed) is taken by rule (standards 26). It costs nothing: it replaced Purifying Power, which does nothing on this boss.
5 ahead of the twist build at 120s, 4.0 at 180s and 8 at 300s: the twist build's Precision puts its hit over the 8% cap.
Purifying Power does nothing on the generic boss.
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts Holy seal damage (Era sim choice, the client says Physical only). Without it: -11.
No filler explosive (standards 11): the Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 4.9 at 180s, the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 5.7 (each 1s cast resets the swing).
notes: mksettings writes primarySeal Righteousness; set to Command to match the shipped preset's options (the APL never uses Cast Primary Seal, so DPS is unaffected). Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human.
